lede: Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia is the day's connective thread, surfacing at once on Bluesky, the AI news wire, Polymarket and Wikipedia. The board says it will not reinstate him, and traders price his return by year end at about 8 percent. Against that, Robert Pattinson quietly topped Wikipedia with 840,972 views, nearly double the second-place article, and nothing else in the day's feeds explains the surge.

throughlines.title: Will Jensen Huang rejoin NVIDIA by December 31, 2026?
throughlines.gist: Four feeds converge on the same question after Nvidia's chief executive departed, whether Jensen Huang comes back, which Polymarket now prices at about 8 percent.

throughlines.title: Grand Theft Auto VI
throughlines.gist: The Grand Theft Auto franchise lands on three feeds at once, the unreleased sixth game leading Wikipedia while older titles hold places on Steam and YouTube.

throughlines.title: Will Mary Peltola win the Alaska Senate race in 2026?
throughlines.gist: Alaska's Senate race shows up on both Mastodon and Polymarket, where the market puts a Mary Peltola win at better than 99 percent as posts call it already closed.
